speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing your symptoms. To better understand the cause of your fatigue, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph node, can you tell me how long these symptoms have been present?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: The duration of four weeks combined with "drenching" night sweats and significant weight loss is concerning for a serious underlying condition, possibly malignancy or tuberculosis. Have you noticed any fever, cough, or changes in your bowel habits recently?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma

The combination of supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, significant weight loss, drenching night sweats, and abdominal pain over a short period is highly suggestive of a lymphoproliferative disorder. I request a biopsy of the lymph node and a CT scan of the abdomen and chest to confirm the diagnosis and stage the disease. REQUEST TEST: Lymph_Node_Biopsy, REQUEST IMAGES: CT_Abdomen_Pelvis, CT_Chest.
